lines.en: I pace around my anchor point.
My microphone rests on my shoulder.
I walk toward the applause.
Solid ground under my feet.
My steps keep a rhythm.
I shake my head, red hair flying.
A crown sits on my head.
I go around the stone in the road.
I circle the plains once.
I keep time as I walk.
I hear a beat far off.
I tread over the sun-dried grass.
I plant the microphone by my foot.
One shout of mine shatters stone.
I am waiting for an audience.
I hum a tune without words.
I touch the horn on my head.
Too empty here to sing.
I sit cross-legged.
I stand up again.
I count the beats in my head.
I look at my own shadow.

lines.zh: 锚点还在，我就不会走远
lines.en: My anchor holds; I will not stray.
I tighten my bracer.
I want to sing something new.
But there are no words yet.
Have you come to listen?
I've seen you out on the plains.
You are close enough; perfect.
I lift my chin at you.
Do you want to request a song?
I do not charge for singing.
You frowned.
Is my singing bad?
I am the king, you know.
Give me a beat.
I wait for your answer.
The moment you speak, I begin.
I bow to you.
Did you hear me sing?
I remember what you gave me.

lines.zh: 你要是想听，我就再来一首
lines.en: If you want more, I will sing again.

lines.zh: 我戴着王冠，还握着麦克风。
lines.en: Crowned, with a mic in hand.
I nearly dropped the microphone.
That interrupted me.
I grit my teeth and hold.
I can still sing.
This does not break my rhythm.
I take two breaths.
I adjust my bracer.
My crown has tilted a little.
My speaker is still ringing.
This is for me, right?
I take it and eat.
This smells good.
I hum while I eat.
I will sing again after eating.
I smell something metallic.
Give me a taste.
I eat quite quickly.

lines.zh: 谢谢，这句话我说得挺顺
lines.en: Thank you; that one I say well.
Let us eat together.
This is not enough for a song.
But enough to start one.
You bumped me; the microphone swayed.
I caught it at once.
I am too heavy to shove.
That broke my rhythm.
I step back and count again.
Do not touch my microphone.

lines.zh: 我的护腕撞在你的肩上
lines.en: My bracer knocks against your shoulder.
My pauldron catches against you.
Step aside; I am about to sing.
Get your feet steady first.
I will sing for you, free of charge.
This one is new.
The words just came to me.
Just hear me out.
Do not look away.
I lower the microphone.

lines.zh: 这里只有我们两个，听我唱。
lines.en: Only the two of us here; hear my song.
It is done; what do you think?
If you say nothing, I will take it as praise.
Then one more.
I stoop and pick it up.

lines.zh: 这个当麦克风架子不错
lines.en: This would make a good mic stand.
I hold it up and look closely.
I shoulder it.
I pinch it up between two fingers.

lines.zh: 我把它收进腰间的袋子
lines.en: I tuck it into the pouch at my waist.
This cannot go in my mouth.
Keep it if it is useful.
Now I have the whole kit.
Then we go now.
My mic is pointed right at you.
The microphone is up.
This one is written for you.

lines.zh: 扬声器里传出一声低鸣
lines.en: A low hum comes from my speaker.
This will be loud.
My legs are planted.
I will not yield half a step.
Do you hear the beat?
That is me counting time.
This move is called Disc Attack.
This disc is ready to fly.
Do not cover your ears.
That will do no good.
Then let us play.
Careful, here it comes.

lines.zh: 这一下会比你想象的近
lines.en: This will land nearer than you think.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的步子打拍子
lines.en: I keep time with your steps.

lines.zh: 你往左，我的节拍就往左
lines.en: You go left; my beat goes left.
The king's shout comes before the blow.
The microphone stay pointed at you.
I am a few steps away.
I can reach you from range.
My rhythm has caught up with you.
That suits my mood exactly.
My rhythm has not broken.
You are already falling behind.
This one goes to your flank.
Listen; the beat stopped.
That is me gathering strength.
It will sound in a moment.
That note rang true.
This set is finished.
I swing the microphone.
That blow had rhythm.

lines.zh: 我这一嗓子，草原都听见。
lines.en: One shout of mine carries over the savanna.
My crown rams into your chest.
My fist and my song arrive together.
That one was the accent.

lines.zh: 王者的一吼，你退了两步。
lines.en: One kingly shout, and you step back twice.
The King's Disc flies out.
Thanks for coming along.
Can you still get up?
Get up first.
I want to sing another.

lines.zh: 我把麦克风往地上一立
lines.en: I plant the microphone on the ground.

lines.zh: 我的扬声器先震了一下
lines.en: My speaker crackles to life first.
The wind around me has stopped.

lines.zh: 我朝空地中间走了两步
lines.en: I walk two steps into the clearing.
This will do as a stage.
I glance up at the sky.
Today is perfect for singing.
I toss my red hair.
I straighten my collar.
Someone is watching from afar.
Then let us begin now.
I raised the microphone.
One song, one audience.

lines.zh: 王者的麦克风已经举起来。
lines.en: The king's microphone is already raised.
I will start singing.
No need to leave until you hear it.
A lock of my red hair is scorched.
My knee buckles on landing.

lines.zh: 水进了我的喉咙，唱不出来
lines.en: Water in my throat; I cannot sing.
The blast rolls me over.
Something sticks in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 那道力量让我的声音卡住
lines.en: That force catches my voice.
Too hungry to sing.
Lightning strikes my microphone.
There is no stage to stand on.
